Translation.Video Subject Placeholder: Ejemplo: Cómo la IA cambia la vida cotidiana
Translation.Custom Script Requirements Placeholder: Ejemplo: usa un tono más ligero, estilo TikTok, dirigido a jóvenes y crea una apertura más intrigante
Translation.Generate Video Script and Keywords: Generar guion y palabras clave con IA
Translation.Video Script Help: Déjalo vacío para generarlo con IA a partir del tema del vídeo. Una puntuación adecuada ayuda a generar los subtítulos.
Translation.Please Enter the Video Subject: Introduce primero el guion del vídeo
Translation.Please Enter the Video Subject First: Introduce primero el tema del vídeo
Translation.No Tasks Match Filter: Ninguna tarea coincide con el filtro
Translation.Task Delete Failed: No se pudo eliminar la tarea
Translation.Generating Video Script and Keywords: La IA está generando el guion y las palabras clave del vídeo...
Translation.Generating Video Keywords: La IA está generando las palabras clave del vídeo...
Translation.Video Keywords Help: Déjalo vacío para generarlas con IA a partir del guion. Separa varias palabras clave con comas inglesas.
Translation.Clip Duration Help: Controla la duración de cada clip utilizado, no la duración total del vídeo.
Translation.Clip Speed Help: Solo ajusta la reproducción del material visual. La locución, los subtítulos y la duración máxima de salida de cada clip no cambian.
Translation.Match Materials to Script Order: Ajustar imágenes al orden del guion
Translation.Match Materials to Script Order Help: Genera términos y ordena el material según el guion para que las imágenes sigan la narración.
Translation.Voiceover Volume Help: Ajusta el volumen de la locución automática o subida. 100 % mantiene el nivel original.
Translation.Voiceover Speed Help: Solo se aplica a la locución automática. 1,0× es la velocidad normal.
Translation.Upload Voiceover File Help: El audio subido se usa directamente en lugar de generar una locución.
Translation.Please Upload Voiceover File First: Sube primero un archivo de locución
Translation.Custom audio will be used directly. TTS: La locución subida se usará directamente; no se generará una locución automática.
Translation.Sonilo Background Music: Música automática adaptada al video (Sonilo AI)
Translation.Sonilo Music Prompt Help: Indicación opcional de estilo o emoción, hasta 2000 caracteres. Déjalo vacío para que Sonilo se adapte al video.
Translation.Sonilo Multiple Videos Warning: Sonilo genera música por separado para cada video, por lo que varios videos consumen varias generaciones.
Translation.Sonilo API Key Required: Introduce una clave API de Sonilo para usar su música de fondo.
Translation.Sonilo BGM Fallback Warning: El video {index} se generó sin música de Sonilo porque falló la solicitud de música.
Translation.ElevenLabs API Key Help: Esta clave se comparte con ElevenLabs TTS, se oculta y se guarda en tu config.toml local.
Translation.ElevenLabs Music Prompt Help: Indicación opcional de estilo o emoción, hasta 1000 caracteres. Déjalo vacío para que ElevenLabs se adapte al video.
Translation.ElevenLabs Multiple Videos Warning: ElevenLabs genera música por separado para cada video, por lo que varios videos consumen varias generaciones.
Translation.ElevenLabs API Key Required: Introduce una clave API de ElevenLabs para usar su música de fondo.
Translation.ElevenLabs Connection Test Succeeded: La cuenta y el plan de ElevenLabs son válidos. El acceso a Music API se confirmará durante la generación.
Translation.ElevenLabs Connection Test Failed: Falló la comprobación de la cuenta de ElevenLabs: {error}
Translation.ElevenLabs Paid Plan Required: La clave API es válida, pero la API de música de ElevenLabs requiere un plan de pago. Actualiza la cuenta antes de generar música.
Translation.ElevenLabs BGM Fallback Warning: El video {index} se generó sin música de ElevenLabs porque falló la solicitud de música.
Translation.Custom Background Music File: O introduce una ruta de música personalizada
Translation.Upload Background Music Help: Sube un archivo MP3, M4A, AAC, WAV, FLAC, OGG, OPUS o WMA de hasta 30 MB. Se guardará de forma permanente al iniciar la generación del vídeo.
Translation.Background Music Ready: La música de fondo está lista
Translation.Invalid Background Music: Sube un archivo de música de fondo válido y compatible de hasta 30 MB.
Translation.Background Music Validation Failed: No se pudo validar la música de fondo porque FFmpeg o el almacenamiento no están disponibles. Revisa los registros del servidor.
Translation.Custom Position (% from top): Posición personalizada (% desde la parte superior)
Translation.Rounded Subtitle Background Help: Desactivado por defecto. Cuando está activado, el fondo de los subtítulos usa un estilo redondeado y translúcido que se adapta mejor al ancho del texto.
Translation.Subtitle Colors Are Indistinguishable: El texto y el fondo tienen el mismo color, por lo que los subtítulos pueden no verse.
Translation.Subtitle Font Does Not Support Text: La fuente elegida no admite algunos caracteres del guion, por lo que pueden faltar subtítulos.
Translation.Video Script and Subject Cannot Both Be: El tema y el guion del vídeo no pueden estar ambos vacíos
Translation.Video Generation Failed: Error en la generación de vídeo
Translation.You can download the generated video fro: Puedes descargar el vídeo generado desde los siguientes enlaces
Translation.Account ID: ID de cuenta (Obtén desde el panel de Cloudflare)
Translation.Groq Model List Load Failed: No se pudo cargar la lista de modelos de Groq. Puedes introducir un modelo manualmente; se validará durante la generación.
Translation.Groq API Key Required for Model List: Añade una clave API de Groq para cargar automáticamente los modelos disponibles.
Translation.Get Help: Si necesitas ayuda o tienes alguna pregunta, únete a Discord para obtener ayuda: https://harryai.cc
Translation.Please Select a Valid Video Source: Selecciona una fuente de vídeo válida
Translation.Please Upload Local Materials First: Sube primero al menos un archivo multimedia local.
Translation.Unsupported Upload File Type: El tipo de archivo subido no es compatible.
Translation.Voice Example: Este es un texto de ejemplo para probar la síntesis de voz
Translation.Estimated Voiceover Duration: Duración estimada: {min}–{max} s (cálculo local, sin llamar a la API)
Translation.Voiceover Script Required: Añade un guion para estimar y previsualizar la locución completa.
Translation.Full Voiceover Preview Cost Hint: La vista completa llama al servicio TTS y puede consumir créditos de API.
Translation.Voice Preview No Audio: El servicio TTS no devolvió audio. Revisa la configuración y los registros.
Translation.Voice Preview Busy: Una tarea de vídeo está usando la configuración de voz. Inténtalo de nuevo en breve.
Translation.Voice Preview Duration Unavailable: El audio se generó, pero no se pudo leer su duración. Revisa los registros.
Translation.TTS Provider: Selecciona el proveedor de síntesis de voz
Translation.No voices available for the selected TTS: No hay voces disponibles para el servidor TTS seleccionado. Selecciona otro servidor.
Translation.ElevenLabs Free Tier Voice Filter: {count} Voice Library voice(s) were hidden because ElevenLabs does not allow them through the API on the free plan. The remaining voices can be used without upgrading.
Translation.Hide Basic Settings:
Ocultar configuración básica

Oculto, el panel de configuración básica no se mostrará en la página.

Si necesitas mostrarlo de nuevo, establece `hide_config = false` en `config.toml`
Translation.Video Cache Directory: Directorio de caché de vídeos en línea
Translation.Video Cache Management Help: Aquí solo se gestionan los vídeos descargados automáticamente. Los archivos subidos y los vídeos generados no se eliminan. No limpie la caché mientras se genera un vídeo.
Translation.Cache Older Than 30 Days: Caché de hace más de 30 días (recomendado)
Translation.Cache Older Than 7 Days: Caché de hace más de 7 días
Translation.Cache Older Than 90 Days: Caché de hace más de 90 días
Translation.Cache Cleanup Preview: Se eliminarán aproximadamente {count} archivos y se liberarán {size}.
Translation.Confirm Cache Cleanup: Confirmo que deseo eliminar los archivos de caché indicados
Translation.Cache Cleanup Completed: Limpieza completada: se eliminaron {count} archivos y se liberaron {size}.
Translation.Cache Cleanup Completed With Failures: Limpieza parcial: se eliminaron {count} archivos y se liberaron {size}; no se pudieron eliminar {failed} archivos.
Translation.Onboarding Model Settings Title: Paso 1: Configura el modelo de IA
Translation.Onboarding Model Settings Description: Después del recorrido, abre Configuración, elige un proveedor, introduce la clave API, la URL base y el modelo, y prueba la conexión.
Translation.Onboarding Creation Settings Description: Introduce un tema y ajusta el video, el audio y los subtítulos según sea necesario. Puedes conservar la mayoría de los valores predeterminados.
Translation.Onboarding Generate Video Description: Inicia la generación después de revisar la configuración. Consulta el progreso y los resultados en el Administrador de tareas.
Translation.Regenerate Task Confirmation: ¿Cargar el guion y la configuración de esta tarea? Se reemplazarán los valores actuales, pero no se modificarán la tarea ni el video originales.
Translation.Task Restore Failed: Esta tarea no contiene una configuración reutilizable.
Translation.Task Configuration Loaded: Se cargó la configuración histórica. Revísala y pulsa Generar video.
Translation.Task Restore Local Materials Warning: Los archivos locales no se pueden restaurar automáticamente. Vuelve a cargarlos.
Translation.Task Restore Custom Audio Warning: El audio personalizado no se puede restaurar automáticamente. Vuelve a cargarlo.
Translation.Video Encoder Help: Opción avanzada. Predeterminado sigue la política estable de la aplicación, actualmente libx264. Si un codificador de hardware no está disponible, la aplicación vuelve automáticamente a libx264.
Translation.Video Encoder Check Passed: Comprobación del codificador superada: {codec} está activo.
Translation.Video Encoder Check Fallback: Comprobación completada con alternativa: se usa {used_codec} en lugar de {configured_codec}.
Translation.Video Encoder Check Failed: La comprobación del codificador falló. Use libx264 o compruebe el controlador de la GPU.
Translation.Pending Metrics Sync Summary: Sincronización de métricas completada: {synced} sincronizadas, {skipped} omitidas, {errors} errores.
Translation.Last Metrics Sync Summary: Última sincronización de métricas ({recorded_at}): {synced} sincronizadas, {no_data} esperando datos, {transient} errores temporales, {permanent} requieren atención.
Translation.Last Metrics Sync Not Configured: La última sincronización de métricas ({recorded_at}) no se ejecutó porque Upload-Post no está configurado.
Translation.Sync Metrics Retry Scheduled: Las métricas aún no están disponibles. El trabajo se volverá a intentar automáticamente.
Translation.Sync Metrics Failed: No se pudieron sincronizar las métricas. Revise la configuración de Upload-Post e inténtelo de nuevo.
Translation.Use Custom System Prompt Help: Cuando está activado, reemplaza las reglas predeterminadas de generación de guiones. Pensado para usuarios avanzados de prompts.
Translation.Additional Output Formats Help: Genera opcionalmente el mismo video con relaciones de aspecto adicionales. La relación principal sigue siendo la usada para buscar material.
Translation.Speed: Range [0.25, 4.0], default is 1.0: Velocidad: Rango [0.25, 4.0], el valor predeterminado es 1.0
Translation.Volume: Uses Speech Volume setting, defa: Volumen: Usa la configuración de volumen de voz, 1.0 predeterminado equivale a ganancia 0
Translation.Uses Xiaomi MiMo V2.5 TTS preset voices: Usa voces preestablecidas de TTS Xiaomi MiMo V2.5
Translation.Speed and volume are currently handled b: La velocidad y el volumen están gestionados por los valores predeterminados del proveedor
Translation.Click to show API Key management: Haz clic para mostrar la gestión de API Keys
Translation.Manage Pexels and Pixabay API Keys: Gestionar API Keys de Pexels y Pixabay
Translation.No Pexels API Keys currently: No hay API Keys de Pexels actualmente
Translation.Pexels API Key added successfully: API Key de Pexels añadida correctamente
Translation.Select Pexels API Key to delete: Selecciona la API Key de Pexels a eliminar
Translation.Delete Selected Pexels API Key: Eliminar la API Key de Pexels seleccionada
Translation.Pexels API Key deleted successfully: API Key de Pexels eliminada correctamente
Translation.No Pixabay API Keys currently: No hay API Keys de Pixabay actualmente
Translation.Pixabay API Key added successfully: API Key de Pixabay añadida correctamente
Translation.Select Pixabay API Key to delete: Selecciona la API Key de Pixabay a eliminar
Translation.Delete Selected Pixabay API Key: Eliminar la API Key de Pixabay seleccionada
Translation.Pixabay API Key deleted successfully: API Key de Pixabay eliminada correctamente
Translation.Manage Pexels, Pixabay and Coverr API Ke: Gestionar API Keys de Pexels, Pixabay y Coverr
Translation.No Coverr API Keys currently: No hay API Keys de Coverr actualmente
Translation.Coverr API Key added successfully: API Key de Coverr añadida correctamente
Translation.Select Coverr API Key to delete: Selecciona la API Key de Coverr a eliminar
Translation.Delete Selected Coverr API Key: Eliminar la API Key de Coverr seleccionada
Translation.Coverr API Key deleted successfully: API Key de Coverr eliminada correctamente
Translation.Smart B-Roll Queries Help: Generate concrete scene-based search queries from the script, such as family checking bills at kitchen table, instead of short generic keywords. Uses the current LLM provider.
Translation.Video Diversity Level Help: Controls how many result pages are sampled when searching online video materials. 1 keeps the fastest standard search. Higher values can improve variety, but may take longer and use more API quota.
Translation.Avoid Recently Used Videos Help: When enabled, online clips used in the last 7 days are skipped when possible. If too few fresh clips are available, generation falls back to the normal candidate pool.
Translation.Recently Used Video Window Help: Choose how long a used online clip should be treated as recently used. This only affects the checkbox above.
Translation.Cooldown Summary: Cooldown active: {count} recently used candidates were deprioritized for {days} days.
Translation.Similar Subject Warning: Similar topic notice: "{subject}" was generated in the last {days} days ({created_at}). You can continue, but consider changing the angle.
Translation.Similar Subject Fresh Angle Suggestions:
Fresh angles for "{subject}":
- Focus on a different audience or skill level
- Turn it into a mistake, checklist, or myth-busting format
- Add a current-year update, comparison, or concrete example
Translation.Karaoke Word Highlight Help: Uses TTS word or phrase timing to show subtitles piece by piece. Falls back to classic subtitles when timing data is unavailable.
Translation.Presets Panel Help: Reuse saved production settings or import/export them before editing the current project.
Translation.Recent Jobs Panel Help: Review recent renders, thumbnails, quality scores, upload status, and publish metrics.
Translation.Recent Jobs Readiness Help: Check recent outputs, upload review items, thumbnails, and quality score coverage.
Translation.Recent Jobs Ready: Recent outputs are ready for review.
Translation.Recent Jobs Need Output: Generate a video to start building recent job history.
Translation.Recent Jobs Pending Uploads: Some recent jobs are waiting for upload review.
Translation.Video Quality CRF Help: Lower CRF values produce higher quality and larger files. 20 is the default balanced value.
Translation.Video Quality Preset Help: Choose a practical starting point. Use Custom when you want to tune CRF, FPS, bitrate, and encoder preset manually.
Translation.Encoder Preset Help: libx264 speed and compression preset. Slower presets can reduce file size at the same CRF.
Translation.Output FPS Help: Frame rate for generated MP4 files. Use 30 for standard output, or 60 for smoother motion.
Translation.Audio Bitrate Help: Final audio bitrate in kbps. Higher values can improve sound quality and increase file size.
Translation.Batch Generation Panel Help: Prepare multiple subjects or script blocks and keep them ready for batch generation.
Translation.Batch Workflow Help: Prepare batch subjects, optional scripts, quality checks, and generation readiness in order.
Translation.Batch Readiness Help: Shows whether bulk generation has enough inputs to run.
Translation.Batch Subjects Help: Enter one video subject per line. Each line will be generated as a separate video using the current settings.
Translation.Batch Script Blocks Help: Use one block per video. The first line is the subject, the following lines are the script, and --- separates videos.
Translation.Batch Scripts Need Review: Some manual batch scripts are missing.
Translation.Please Enter Batch Subjects: Please enter at least one batch subject
Translation.Content Intelligence Panel Help: Turn the current niche into content ideas, hooks, and batch-ready calendar items.
Translation.Content Niche Help: Enter a niche or topic to plan around. Optional planning context can be enabled below, but results are not popularity or virality claims.
Translation.Use Static Trend Context Help: Adds optional planning context. Static context is built in; RSS uses recent headlines only as editorial context.
Translation.Trend Context Source Help: Choose the source for optional planning context. RSS headlines are not ranking, popularity, or virality data.
Translation.Apply First Idea to Current Topic: Apply First Idea to Current Topic
Translation.Content Plan Applied to Batch: Content plan applied to batch subjects
Translation.Social Metadata Panel Help: Prepare platform-specific titles, captions, and hashtags for the final video.
Translation.Social Metadata Stale Warning: Social metadata was generated for older inputs. Regenerate it before publishing.
Translation.Please Enter the Video Subject or Script: Please enter the video subject or script
Translation.Publishing Settings Panel Help: Choose upload defaults and public-release safeguards before automatic posting.
Translation.Upload-Post Config Hint: Upload-Post API key and username must be set in config.toml. Automatic upload is off by default.
Translation.Upload-Post Enabled Help: Allows generated videos to be uploaded through the configured Upload-Post account.
Translation.Auto Upload After Video Help: When enabled, completed videos are sent to the configured platforms. Keep this off until your account settings are ready.
Translation.YouTube Privacy Status Help: Private is safest. Unlisted is useful for review links. Public publishes to everyone and requires an extra confirmation.
Translation.Allow Public YouTube Upload: I confirm YouTube public publishing is allowed
Translation.Allow Public YouTube Upload Help: Without this extra confirmation, public YouTube uploads are safely sent as private.
Translation.Public YouTube Upload Warning: WARNING: This can publish videos publicly on your YouTube channel. Review the content before enabling this.
Translation.Public YouTube Upload Blocked: Public is selected, but the confirmation is off. The backend will send YouTube uploads as private.
Translation.Upload-Post Not Configured: Upload-Post is not configured. Add the API key and username before uploading.
Translation.Confirm Public Upload: I confirm this video will be published publicly on YouTube
Translation.Confirm Public Upload Help: Required only when YouTube privacy is public.
Translation.Upload Video Missing: Video file was not found locally. Regenerate the video or check the file path before uploading.
Translation.Manual Video Selection Help: Search candidate clips first, then choose exactly which online videos should be used for generation.
Translation.Please Select at Least One Video Candida: Please select at least one video candidate
Translation.Viral Analysis Panel Help: Score the current script and compare improvement suggestions before applying them.
Translation.Auto Viral Analysis After Video Help: Disabled by default to avoid extra LLM usage. Enable it when you want each completed video to get a pre-publish hook and pacing review.
Translation.Content Preflight Help: Run a quick topic and script check before generating. This is advisory and never blocks generation.
Translation.Content Preflight Missing Warning: Content preflight has not been run for the current inputs. Generation will continue.
Translation.Content Preflight Stale Warning: Content preflight was generated for older inputs. Generation will continue.
Translation.Viral Quality Gate Enabled Help: When enabled, low preflight viral scores show a warning only. Generation is not blocked.
Translation.Viral Quality Gate Threshold Help: Warn when the latest fresh preflight score is below this value.
Translation.Viral Quality Gate Warning: Viral score is {score}/100, below the warning threshold of {threshold}/100. Generation will continue.
Translation.Quality Gate Calibration Summary: {samples} publish metric samples. Suggested warning threshold: {threshold}/100.
Translation.Improve Script Help: Generate an alternative script from the viral analysis. The original script is not changed until you apply it.
Translation.Improve Script Unavailable: Could not generate an improved script: {error}
Translation.Script Improvement Comparison Help: Compare the current script with the AI suggestion before applying it.
Translation.Rewrite Improves Score: The suggested rewrite improves the overall score.
Translation.Rewrite Lowers Score: The suggested rewrite lowers the overall score. Review before applying.
Translation.Rewrite Score Unknown: Score comparison is not available. Review the rewrite manually.
Translation.Production Hub Description: Create the topic and script, review quality signals, then generate from the same production desk.
Translation.Production Step Flow Help: Use the tabs below as a workflow: set up the video, review quality, then prepare final generation.
Translation.Production Step Setup Description: Topic, script, media, voice, and output settings.
Translation.Production Step Quality Check Descriptio: Content preflight, viral score, and script improvement.
Translation.Production Step Preview Description: Final checks, generation actions, and recent outputs.
Translation.Final Readiness Help: Final check before rendering: topic, script, quality signals, social text, and publishing status.
Translation.Final Readiness Needs Subject: Add a topic before generating the video.
Translation.Final Readiness Needs Script: Add or generate a script before rendering.
Translation.Final Readiness Needs Preflight: Content preflight has not been run or needs refresh.
Translation.Final Readiness Needs Viral Analysis: Viral analysis is missing for the current script.
Translation.Final Readiness Needs Social Metadata: Social media text is not ready yet.
Translation.Final Readiness Ready: The main checks are ready for generation.
Translation.Distribution Readiness Help: Check social metadata, publishing status, and upload safety before generation.
Translation.Distribution Workflow Help: Prepare captions first, then review publishing, auto-upload, and YouTube visibility.
Translation.Distribution Needs Social Metadata: Social media text has not been generated yet.
Translation.Distribution Public Upload Needs Approva: Public YouTube upload is selected but still needs explicit approval.
Translation.Distribution Publishing Optional: Publishing is disabled; the video will still be rendered locally.
Translation.Batch History Readiness Help: Check queued batch ideas, recent outputs, and calibration samples in one place.
Translation.Batch Ready for Generation: Batch items are ready for generation.
Translation.Batch History Has Recent Jobs: No batch is queued, but recent jobs are available for review.
Translation.Batch Needs Ideas: Add batch subjects or script blocks to prepare bulk generation.
Translation.Preset Readiness Help: Check saved presets, starter presets, and active video sources before editing settings.
Translation.Built-in Presets Available: Starter presets are available for this project.
Translation.Preset Needs Save: No preset is saved yet; save the current setup after tuning it.
Translation.Content Plan Readiness Help: Review plan source, idea count, calendar coverage, and warnings before using the plan.
Translation.Content Plan Needs Ideas: No content ideas are available yet.
Translation.Content Plan Needs Review: The content plan has warnings that should be reviewed.
Translation.Content Plan Ready: Content plan is ready to use.
Translation.Quality Check Workspace Help: Run preflight, review viral potential, and improve the script before final generation.
Translation.Quality Gate Review Help: Use the current checks to decide whether to refresh analysis, improve the script, or move to preview.
Translation.Quality Workflow Help: Follow the production checks in order: plan, preflight, viral score, then script improvement.
Translation.Quality Warning Checklist Help: Review the strongest warnings before moving to preview.
Translation.Quality Decision Needs Input Help: Add a topic or script before reviewing quality.
Translation.Quality Decision Needs Preflight Help: Run topic analysis to check repeats, hooks, and planning risks.
Translation.Quality Decision Refresh Preflight Help: The topic or script changed after the last analysis.
Translation.Quality Decision Needs Viral Analysis He: Score the current script before deciding whether to improve it.
Translation.Quality Decision Review Rewrite Help: An improved script is ready; compare it before applying.
Translation.Quality Decision Low Score Help: The current quality gate threshold is not met.
Translation.Quality Decision Review Warnings Help: There are preflight or viral warnings to inspect before generation.
Translation.Quality Decision Ready Help: Quality checks look ready for the final generation step.
Translation.Production Workspace Help: A compact map of presets, batch work, content intelligence, publishing, quality checks, and recent output.
Translation.Workspace Tab Setup Help: Save, import, and reuse production presets before changing the current project.
Translation.Workspace Tab Planning Quality Help: Create content plans, run preflight checks, score viral potential, and review script improvements.
Translation.Workspace Tab Distribution Help: Prepare social captions, hashtags, platform metadata, and upload defaults.
Translation.Workspace Tab Batch History Help: Prepare batch subjects, inspect recent jobs, and record publish metrics.
Translation.Generate Actions Help: Render one video now or run the prepared batch queue.
Translation.Subject: Subject
Translation.Sync Metrics No Data: No Upload-Post metrics were available yet.
Translation.Generate Decision Help: Shows the safest next production action before rendering.
Translation.Generate Decision Ready: Single video is ready to generate.
Translation.Generate Decision Batch Ready: Batch subjects are ready for bulk generation.
Translation.Accounts API Readiness Help: Checks AI, media, voice, and publishing setup without showing secrets.
Translation.Accounts LLM Needs Key: The selected AI provider needs an API key.
Translation.Accounts Media Needs Source: Add a media source or API key before generation.
Translation.Accounts Source Needs Configuration: These enabled sources still need configuration: {sources}.
Translation.Accounts Upload Needs Key: Upload-Post is enabled but missing an API key.
Translation.Accounts Ready: Core accounts and API settings look ready.
Translation.Video Source Configuration Help: Checks selected sources locally. It does not spend API quota or send a generation request.
Translation.Performance Snapshot Help: Summarizes publish metrics against viral score predictions for recent jobs.
Translation.Monthly Cost Estimate Help: Muestra la parte conocida de las estimaciones aproximadas de LLM y TTS de este mes. Los trabajos sin tarifas configuradas se excluyen del total.
Translation.Cost Estimate Needs Rates: {count} trabajo(s) no tienen tarifas de coste. El total solo incluye estimaciones conocidas.
Translation.Analytics Needs Publish Metrics: Add publish metrics to calibrate future decisions.
Translation.Analytics Needs Viral Scores: Some metric samples are missing viral scores.
Translation.Analytics Ready: Publish metrics and viral scores are ready for review.
Translation.Brand CTA Soft: Invite viewers to follow for the next insight.
Translation.Brand CTA Direct: Ask viewers to follow, comment, or save.
Translation.Brand CTA Informational: Point viewers to the next related explanation.
Translation.Video Quality Impact Help: Practical effect of the current CRF, FPS, encoder preset, and audio bitrate settings.
Translation.Content Performance Feedback: Temas con alto rendimiento: {strong}. Revisa o mejora: {weak}.
Translation.Material Benchmark Help: Runs a read-only candidate search for this topic. It does not download media, select materials, or change settings.
Translation.Material Benchmark Failed: Material benchmark could not complete. Check the configured material providers and try again.
Translation.Material Benchmark No Candidates: No material candidates were found for this topic.
Translation.Video Generation Partially Completed: Video generation completed with some output formats unavailable: {failed_aspects}.
Translation.Video Generation Failed Formats: Video generation failed for output formats: {failed_aspects}.
Translation.Batch Generation Completed With Partial: Batch generation completed with partial outputs for: {subjects}.
Translation.Subtitle Timing Approximate: Los tiempos de los subtítulos son aproximados porque el reconocimiento de voz no estaba disponible. Revise los tiempos antes de publicar.
Translation.Subtitle Layout Ready: Subtitle layout is ready for {cue_count} cue(s).
Translation.Subtitle Layout Needs Review: Subtitle layout needs review: {issue_count} potential issue(s) across {cue_count} cue(s).
Translation.Material Review Help: Review whether the visual material suits this video. Source adjustments begin only after enough reviews.
Translation.Material Review Provider Unavailable: The review will be saved for this task, but no single material source could be identified.
Translation.Material Feedback Save Failed: Material feedback could not be saved.
Translation.Subtitle Contrast Warning: Subtitle colors have low contrast ({ratio}:1). Choose colors with at least 4.5:1 contrast.
Translation.Subtitle Custom Position Warning: Custom subtitle placement is close to the frame edge. Check the rendered preview.
Translation.Normalize Narration Loudness Help: Keeps TTS or uploaded narration at a more consistent listening level. The original uploaded file stays unchanged.
Translation.Video Sources Help: Multiple sources are searched in parallel and the best clips are selected automatically.
Translation.Video Sources Minimum: Select at least one source. Pexels is used by default.
Translation.Video Transition Mode Help: Choose how clips meet. Crossfade blends clips gently and is the recommended default.
Translation.OpenMontage Matching Video Found: A matching OpenMontage video was found: {project_name}.
Translation.OpenMontage Video Selected: OpenMontage video selected as local material.
Translation.OpenMontage Quality Review Recommended: This OpenMontage render is native, but its bitrate is low. Review it visually or re-render it with production quality before using it.
Translation.OpenMontage Output Needs Native Render: This OpenMontage video is not a valid native render for the selected format. Render it in the selected format before using it.
Translation.Europeana API Key: Europeana API Key ([Get a free key](https://api.europeana.eu/))
Translation.Europeana API Key Help: Used only when photo fallback is needed. MPT accepts only Europeana records explicitly marked CC0 or Public Domain Mark.
Translation.Local Material Library Help: Tag saved files, review suggested matches, then choose exactly which local materials to use.
Translation.Local Material Library Local Source Only: Choose only Local file as the video source before using saved local materials.
Translation.Please Select At Least One Local Materia: Select at least one local material first.
Translation.Selected Local Materials Ready: Selected local materials are ready for this video.
Translation.Public-Domain Source Help: Choose a source only after confirming this file's reuse right on its original source page.
Translation.Prioritize Cleaner Preview Frames Help: Prioritizes the strongest of the top few stock-video previews before downloading full files. The existing weak-preview safeguard remains active; this can make material search take a little longer.
Translation.Select Vecteezy API Key to delete: Select Vecteezy API key to delete
Translation.Vecteezy Account ID Help: Enter the numeric account ID shown in your Vecteezy developer dashboard. The Free plan requires attribution for downloaded clips.
Translation.Smithsonian Open Access API Key: Smithsonian Open Access API Key ([Get a free key](https://api.data.gov/))
Translation.Smithsonian Open Access API Key Help: Used only when photo fallback is needed; MPT accepts only CC0 images.
Translation.Please Enter the Vecteezy Account ID: Please enter the Vecteezy Account ID
Translation.Please enter a valid Vecteezy Account ID: Please enter a valid numeric Vecteezy Account ID
Translation.Visual Review Help: Create local frame previews and subtitle-safe-zone checks for this finished video. Nothing is uploaded.
Translation.Visual Review Failed: A visual review could not be created for this output.
Translation.No Visual Review Previews: No visual previews could be produced.
Translation.Visual Pacing Balanced: Visual pacing is balanced: {seconds_per_visual}s per visual across {visual_count} planned visuals.
Translation.Visual Pacing Needs Review: Visual pacing may need review: {seconds_per_visual}s per visual across {visual_count} planned visuals.
Translation.Visual Pacing Scene Coverage Needs Revie: Only {scene_count} scene query/queries are available for {visual_count} planned visuals.
Translation.Visual Pacing Cue Alignment: {aligned_cuts} of {cut_count} planned cuts align with subtitle cues.
Translation.Visual Reuse Check Help: On demand, samples recent finished videos for repeated visuals. It does not change any video or source setting.
Translation.Visual Reuse Summary: Checked {scanned_count} recent video(s); found {duplicate_count} potential reused visual pair(s).
Translation.Visual Reuse Found: Potential visual reuse found. Review recent outputs and use broader scene queries or sources before the next run.
Translation.Visual Reuse Clear: No potential visual reuse found in this sample.
Translation.Visual Reuse Unreadable: {count} recent video(s) could not be sampled for visual reuse.
Translation.Visual Reuse No Videos: No finished videos are available to check yet.
Translation.Render Quality Aspect Mismatch: Video resolution does not match the selected aspect.
Translation.Render Quality Duration Mismatch: Video duration differs from audio duration.
Translation.Render Quality Missing Audio Help: Check the custom audio file or voice setting, then render again.
Translation.Render Quality Near Silent Audio Help: Check the custom audio file or voice volume, then render again.
Translation.Render Quality Encoding Inspection Faile: Video encoding details could not be verified.
Translation.Render Quality Codec Contract Mismatch: Video codec does not match the expected output.
Translation.Render Quality Pixel Format Contract Mis: Video pixel format does not match the expected output.
Translation.Render Quality Color Metadata Contract M: Video color metadata does not match the expected output.
Translation.Render Quality Frame Rate Contract Misma: Video frame rate does not match the expected output.
Translation.Render Quality Keyframe Interval Mismatc: Video keyframe spacing is wider than expected.
Translation.Render Quality Encoding Contract Help: Run Check Video Encoder. If the warning persists, verify FFmpeg or use libx264 and render again.
Translation.Render Quality Caption Over Black: Captions appear over a black visual.
Translation.Render Quality Near Black Help: Review the listed timestamps. If the dark frame was not intentional, use a different source clip.
Translation.Render Quality Caption Over Black Help: Review the listed timestamps. If the black visual was not intentional, replace or shorten that source clip.
Translation.Render Quality Inspection Failed: Rendered video could not be inspected.
Translation.Render Quality Color Inconsistent: Color character varies across sampled frames.
Translation.Render Quality Color Inconsistent Help: Try different source clips or keep Crossfade enabled to make color changes feel less abrupt.
Translation.Reduce Color Banding Help: Reduces visible color bands in compressed video material. It may slightly soften fine texture, so it is off by default.
Translation.Preflight Script Repeat Warning: A recent script is very similar. Review it before generating.
Translation.AI Disclosure Review Help: Review the platform's AI or synthetic-content disclosure requirement before uploading.
Translation.Confirm AI Disclosure Review: I reviewed the AI content disclosure
Translation.Confirm AI Disclosure Review Help: Confirm that you reviewed the platform's disclosure requirement for this upload.
Translation.Publish Insights Insufficient Data: {samples} of {minimum} metric samples are available. Collect more before changing the workflow.
Translation.Publish Insights Advisory: Read-only: these insights never change generation or publishing settings automatically.
Translation.Publish Insight Collect Metrics: Capture metrics for more published videos before changing the production workflow.
Translation.Publish Insight Manual Review: Use these aggregated results as a review aid; generation and publishing settings are not changed automatically.
Translation.Publish Insight Quality Alignment: Higher script-quality scores align with stronger engagement in this sample; keep the quality gate as a manual review signal.
Translation.Publish Insight Quality Recheck: Higher script-quality scores do not yet align with stronger engagement; review the quality gate manually.
Translation.Publish Insight Quality Inconclusive: Script-quality scores and engagement are too close in this sample to support a workflow change.
Translation.Publish Insight Collect Quality Scores: Collect more script-quality scores before evaluating their relationship to engagement.
Translation.Publish Insight Fallback: Review the available publish metrics manually.
